title: Your Cold Email Sending Infrastructure - Setup to Handover

sections.label: 1 - SIZE THE SETUP
sections.note: How many emails a day you want to send decides how many mailboxes and domains you need. Roughly 30 a day per mailbox, 3 mailboxes per domain, keeps every inbox under the radar.

sections.label: 2 - DOMAINS AND MAILBOXES, NOT ON YOUR MAIN DOMAIN
sections.note: Lookalike sending domains and their mailboxes are provisioned together through a mailbox provider, on your account and your card, about $3 to $4 per mailbox a month. Your main domain never sends cold email, so it can never get burned.

sections.label: 3 - AUTHENTICATION THAT KEEPS YOU OUT OF SPAM
sections.note: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and a custom tracking domain on every sending domain, verified before a single email goes out.

sections.label: 4 - INSTANTLY CONFIGURED TO YOUR SPEC
sections.note: Every mailbox imported into Instantly, warmup running, daily limits ramped, sending schedule, tracking domain, and one unibox where every reply lands.

sections.label: 5 - CLAUDE CONNECTED, THEN HANDOVER
sections.note: Instantly's API wired to Claude so replies get sorted and drafted for you. Everything sits in your accounts with a one page runbook, so you run it without me.
